messages:
Ava (marketing): Heads-up — seeing a 30% increase in unassigned inbound leads in HubSpot since 09:10 PST. Looks correlated w/ enrichment webhook 5xxs to our enrichment service. Not a total outage but many leads never get the HS property that the RR lambda relies on.
Priya (revops): Ugh. Do we know which enrichment step is failing? HS logs or SF mapping?
Ava (marketing): Logs show 502s from enrich-service at /v1/enrich/bulk for a subset of requests. HubSpot retries but by the time it succeeds the claim window has elapsed.
Diego (growth): Impact on conversion? any VIP accounts affected?
Ava (marketing): Early sample: ~40 leads/hr delayed > 10m. No VIPs in the sample, mostly inbound trial signups and webinars.
Sam (ops): I can push a quick fallback rule: when enrichment property is missing, route to the overflow RR pool that assigns to on-call SDRs. That avoids long unowned windows. Need a thumbs if OK.
Priya (revops): Yes please. Also want a short-term SLA change: extend claim window from 2m -> 8m while we stabilize so HS retries can populate props. Can we do that without breaking other circuits?
Sam (ops): We can toggle claim_window in the feature flag: "leadflow.claim_window_seconds". Quick patch: 
```
PATCH /config/feature-flags/leadflow
{ "claim_window_seconds": 480 }
```
Will roll it with a 2-min canary.
Kai (sales-eng): If we move to overflow RR pool, please add a header on leads routed that they were fallback-routed so reps know to follow up differently.
Priya (revops): Agreed. Tag property: "routed_via" = "fallback_enrich". Also capture original owner if present.
Ava (marketing): I'll draft a one-paragraph FYI for reps and post to #sales-ops.
leadflow-bot: alert: enrichment-service /v1/enrich bulk 5xx rate increased from 0.4% -> 12% (09:07 - 09:18 PST). Auto-throttle applied.
Sam (ops): Rolling patch now: 1) set claim_window_seconds=480 (FF canary 10% -> 100% over 10m) 2) add fallback rule in router: if hs_enriched=false -> route=overflow_rr_pool, set routed_via=fallback_enrich 3) enable verbose routing header.
Diego (growth): Can we also enable a short-term metric on 'time_to_owner' and 'first_touch_conversion' for the affected cohort so we can quantify revenue impact?
Priya (revops): I'll add dashboards. Add tag "enrich_incident_3712345678" to the cohort so we can slice it.
Sam (ops): Canary started at 09:28 PST on 10% of traffic. Monitor link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/leadflow/leadflow-routing?panel=3
Ava (marketing): Thanks. I'll notify reps and pause any webinar follow-ups automations that assume immediate enrichment.
Kai (sales-eng): Heads-up to AE leads too — small manual queue for priority AEs. Don't want duplicates.
Priya (revops): Postmortem checklist for the incident: 1) root cause (enrich-service regression) 2) why HS retries didn't preserve claim window 3) why RR logic depended on property timing 4) recovery steps (FF rollback, permanent RR fallback) 5) followups (SLA change proposal). I'll own consolidation.
Sam (ops): Update: canary healthy at 09:34 PST, no route thrash. Increasing to 50% now.
leadflow-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag update applied by sam.ops in canary. ID: ff-3712345678-canary
Ava (marketing): Quick comms draft: "We're seeing intermittent enrichment delays. We've activated a temporary fallback so leads won't remain unassigned; you may see a small increase in fallback-tagged leads. We'll follow up when fully resolved." Approve? :eyes:
Kai (sales-eng): Approve. Add note to not treat fallback tag as disqualifying.
Diego (growth): Also add banner in HubSpot for reps: "Fallback routed due to enrichment delays — proceed as usual."
Priya (revops): Noted — I'll open the postmortem ticket and link dashboards. After rollback we should propose a longer claim_window (5m) as default and harden enrichment retries.
Ava (marketing): Great. Thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread, please.
Sam (ops): Final update: 100% rollout complete at 09:46 PST, fallback routing active. Enrich-service error rate trending down (now 1.3%). Will leave FF at 480s for 2h then evaluate.
leadflow-bot: incident-note: ticket #INC-2026-3712 created for enrich-service regression.
Priya (revops): Added incident tag to cohort. Will draft SLA tweak proposal and circulate.
Ava (marketing): I'll send the rep note and webinar hold message now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
